info.title: Liquidation Ops
info.description: Warehouse operations app for a 3PL parcel-liquidation process (NinjaVan Philippines). This deploy is Phase A of a migration onto Substrait — only the platform-contract routes exist so far; the app's real functionality still runs against Supabase and is not yet exposed as a documented API.

get.summary: Container readiness probe. Always returns 200 with no dependency on the database being reachable.
Echoes the identity headers Substrait's Google-SSO reverse proxy injects, for verifying the SSO integration before the app's real auth model depends on it.

email.description: Value of the X-Forwarded-Email header, or null if absent (e.g. SSO not enabled, or local dev).

user.description: Value of the X-Forwarded-User header, or null if absent.
